description: Ministry of Foreign Affairs - Notify the United Nations ( Sanctions in Relations to Iran) Regulation No. 1 of 2018
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs under the United Nations Act, establishing legal frameworks for implementing UN Security Council sanctions against Iran. It creates new regulatory requirements, prohibitions, and enforcement mechanisms, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
